homepageFeatures.title: Engineered for Concentration & Clarity
homepageFeatures.subtitle: We removed the noise, slow checkouts, and visual clutter to build a reading ecosystem focused purely on comprehension.

items.title: Personal Dedicated Desk
items.description: Your own fixed study desk reserved 24/7 with personal multi-plug power sockets, soft-reading LED lamp, and partition privacy.

items.title: Personal Secure Locker
items.description: Spacious individual lock & key locker for safe storage of heavy reference books, laptops, bags, and study notes.

items.title: Ergonomic Revolving Chair
items.description: 360° revolving executive mesh chairs with breathable backrest, adjustable height, and lumbar support for fatigue-free 12+ hour study sessions.

items.title: Hygienic Pantry Area
items.description: Dedicated clean pantry & refreshment lounge equipped with chilled RO drinking water, hot tea/coffee station, dining tables, and microwave.

items.title: Acoustic Soundproofing & AC
items.description: Calibrated acoustic sound-dampening walls, double-glazed glass, and strict whisper policies ensuring pin-drop silence below 40dB.

items.title: Wi-Fi 7 Gigabit High-Speed Mesh
items.description: Low-latency symmetrical fiber mesh internet with seamless roaming and unlimited bandwidth for video lectures and research.

items.title: 24/7 Biometric Smart Punch
items.description: High-speed fingerprint and smart terminal access for round-the-clock entry with real-time student study hours tracking.

items.title: CCTV Surveillance & Safety
items.description: Full HD CCTV camera coverage with dedicated campus security, female scholar safety protocols, and emergency assistance.
